primary_endpoint: Percentage achieving ≥1-stage fibrosis improvement without worsening NASH at Week 48.
efficacy_outcome: Week 48 response: 28.2% (10 mg), 24.3% (20 mg), and 28.2% (40 mg) vs 30.8% with placebo; respective p-values 0.773, 0.544, and 0.811.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 7/39 (10 mg), 7/37 (20 mg), 8/39 (40 mg), and 3/39 (placebo); deaths: 1, 0, 0, and 1, respectively.
